title: US quarterly options expiration (December 2027) — the year's last monthly-equity expiration, three sessions before the Conference Board's December print
source: OCC: The Options Clearing Corporation's own 2027 Options Expiration Calendar, re-fetched and re-decoded independently this session (2026-09-08) at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) -- the Options Industry Council surface whose legend maps GUID 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B to 'Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading', and whose data array carries exactly that type on 2027-12-17. The December block reads coherently end to end: 12-15 EEF1643B (monthly volatility products), 12-16 15AA2B9D (A.M.-settled index options cease trading), 12-17 the monthly equity / P.M.-settled index marker, 12-24 'Exchange/OCC holiday'. VALIDATED BEFORE BEING TRUSTED, AND VALIDATED HARDER THAN ANY PRIOR SIBLING BECAUSE A SIBLING HAS DEMONSTRATED AN ERROR IN THIS PAYLOAD TWO ROWS AWAY. All 36 monthly-equity rows the payload publishes for 2025-01 through 2027-12 were checked against an independently coded third-Friday-plus-holiday-displacement rule: 36 of 36 agree, including the Juneteenth displacement to Thursday 2027-06-17 that reproduces this repo's opex-2027-06-17, and all five 2026 dates this calendar already holds confirmed (08-21, 09-18, 10-16, 11-20, 12-18). The same payload's MONTHLY VOLATILITY PRODUCTS series was checked against Cboe's own settlement rule and scores 35 of 36 -- the single disagreement being its 2027-12-15 row, exactly the error vix-expiration-2027-10-20 recorded, reproduced here independently. The two series are therefore not equally reliable at the far end of the payload, and this promotion rests on the one that is rule-consistent 36 of 36 and independently derivable: December 2027's Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st, the third is the 17th, and the payload's own 2027 holiday set (Jan 1, Jan 18, Feb 15, Mar 26, May 31, Jun 18, Jul 5, Sep 6, Oct 11 bank, Nov 11 bank, Nov 25, Dec 24) puts no December closure before the 24th that could displace it. PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed on market-events-data.ts's own OCC: prefix; the no-self-confirm convention binds the DISCOVERING sweeps (consumer-confidence-2027-12-22 and fomc-2027-12-08, both 2026-09-08) and this is the independent second look, the precedent opex-2027-09-17, opex-2027-11-19 and fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 record. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), shadowing the TWO proposals that filed this id -- proposals/opex-2027-12-17.from-consumer-confidence-2027-12-22.json and proposals/opex-2027-12-17.from-fomc-2027-12-08.json, both read in full first. Ledger: docs/research/events/opex-2027-12-17.md. THE TWO PROPOSALS DISAGREED ON IMPACT AND THE CALENDAR'S OWN CONVENTION SETTLES IT: high. This calendar files quarterly expirations high (2026-09-18, 2026-12-18, 2027-03-19, 2027-09-17) and monthlies medium (2026-08-21, 2026-10-16, 2026-11-20, 2027-10-15, 2027-11-19); December 2027 is a quarterly, so the consumer-confidence proposal's high is right and the fomc proposal's medium ('matching the other opex-* entries') read the monthly rows. One outlier is noted rather than followed: opex-2027-06-17, also a quarterly, is filed low. THREE INHERITED FRAMINGS ARE CORRECTED, NOT CARRIED. (1) 'THE LAST FULL FRIDAY SESSION OF THE YEAR' IS FALSE. Christmas Day 2027 is a Saturday so Friday 2027-12-24 is a full closure -- OCC's payload marks it 'Exchange/OCC holiday' -- but Friday 2027-12-31 IS a session: NYSE does not observe New Year's Day on the preceding Friday, OCC's payload marks no holiday there and dates a quarterly (quarter-END) expiration on it, and the S&P traded on all five Dec 31s since 1990 that fell on a Friday with Jan 1 on a Saturday (1993, 1999, 2004, 2010, 2021). (2) 'TRIPLE WITCHING' IS UNSOURCED BY THIS LANE. OCC's calendar carries no triple-witching marker; its 'Quarterly Expiration date' type sits on quarter-END dates (03-31, 06-30, 09-30, 12-31), not on third Fridays. The index-FUTURES leg that makes the day 'triple' is a CME fact and cmegroup.com returned 403 twice this session (both in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked), so this entry says quarterly expiration and claims nothing about futures. (3) The Conference Board print is THREE sessions after this expiration, not five -- five is calendar days. WHAT THE LEDGER MEASURED, AND WHAT IT REFUSES. December quarterly expirations are indistinguishable from the other three quarterly months on every channel: against the other 59 quarterlies 2007-2026, the 19 December ones run VIX -0.715 vs -0.201 (P = 0.198), absolute S&P move 0.774% vs 0.688% (P = 0.693) and following-five-session realized vol 0.793 vs 0.988 (P = 0.372); no cell in the twelve-cell Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec family clears 0.05 (lowest 0.0754), family-wise Sidak 0.610. This is the leg the fomc proposal asked for when it warned against reaching for a December-specific volatility cell. THE ONE NUMBER THAT LOOKS LIKE AN EDGE IS DECOMPOSED AND REFUSED: the five sessions AFTER a December expiration return +0.963% against -0.268% for other quarterlies (raw P = 0.064, era-ranked P = 0.0047-0.0075), but against OTHER SESSIONS IN THE SAME DEC 15-24 CALENDAR WINDOW it is +0.963% vs +0.605%, P = 0.487 -- the drift belongs to late December, not to the expiration, and the window itself is not established either (year-level sign test 14 of 19, P = 0.064). Era-ranking made it look STRONGER because it controls for the regime and not for the calendar window; that is this ledger's methodological finding for the family. Quarterly-vs-monthly reproduces as a null (P = 0.800 / 0.990 / 0.921) and opex-2027-10-15's Friday-control kill switch is cleared again on fresh data (0.0040 / 0.0069 / 0.0943). This expiration is NOT a blackout deadline and has NO minutes adjacency: it sits nine calendar days after the 2027-12-08 decision, outside the window that closed 2027-12-09, and twelve days before the proposed 2027-12-29 minutes. symbols is empty; trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|third friday|reconstit|rebalance and return ZERO hits. Confirmed changes what we KNOW, never what we DO.
